data.body:
Triage of the 6 LLM-Review advisories on Gerrit 3366 PS4, each checked against the code and the committed results:
- REAL, filed as vegetarian-mica-phoebe (bug, discovered_from this ticket):
  - (1) Overlap reads only the cap-truncated `advisory` list. Confirmed: 3 of 11 recorded rows have exactly 19 non-DET pipeline findings, which is the 20 cap minus the DET advisory, and `overflow` is never read, so pipeline_only and every overlap total are understated.
  - (2) `--resume` reuses saved items without checking corpus_digest, corpus or match_threshold. Confirmed in main()/run(); a changed corpus or threshold silently mixes stale records.
  - (3) The results record no runner or model. Confirmed: the per-engine records hold only outcome and findings, so the Anthropic-API run is indistinguishable from a Bedrock one.
- NOT filed (latent or test-quality nits):
  - (4) `_default_labels` picks the smallest content hash when several labels files exist. The replay dir holds exactly 1 file today.
  - (5) No end-to-end overlap-numbers test. The matcher is unit-tested; the bug above adds the end-to-end test.
  - (6) A rooting test asserts case_store's `rebar-eval-` temp prefix, a coupling to another module rather than a defect.
